The '''Glymphid''' were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] with [[Color|orange]]<ref name="AEYNTK" /> or red<ref name="HS3" /> colored [[eye]]s and beige, blue, gray,<ref name="AEYNTK" /> green,<ref name="HS3" /> and yellow colored skin. The [[podracer]] [[Aldar Beedo]] from [[Ploo II]] was a Glymphid.<ref name="AEYNTK" />
